3: // Health Archive schema migrations, owned by the Health Archive
4: // lifecycle (ADR-0007: lifecycle owns create/open/migrate). The whole
5: // schema history is one ordered table of (version, name, step); one
6: // loop applies whatever an archive is missing. Adding schema vN+1 is
7: // one new table row plus the currentSchemaVersion bump below.
8: 
9: import (
10: 	"context"
11: 	"database/sql"
12: 	"fmt"
13: 	"time"
14: )
15: 
16: // currentSchemaVersion is the schema version a fully migrated Health
17: // Archive reports via PRAGMA user_version. It must equal the version of
18: // the last row in schemaMigrationTable.
19: const currentSchemaVersion = 23
20: 
21: // schemaMigration is one Health Archive schema step: the version it
22: // migrates an archive *to*, the schema_migrations history name recorded
23: // for it, and the DDL it applies. Steps run inside the caller's
24: // transaction and carry the caller's context (#305) so a canceled
25: // migration aborts at the next statement boundary; the apply loop
26: // records the history row.
27: type schemaMigration struct {
28: 	version int
29: 	name    string
30: 	apply   func(ctx context.Context, tx *sql.Tx) error
31: }
32: 
33: // schemaMigrationTable is the ordered schema history of the Health
34: // Archive. The loop in applySchemaMigrationSteps applies every step
35: // whose version an archive has not reached yet, in table order.
36: func schemaMigrationTable() []schemaMigration {
37: 	return []schemaMigration{
38: 		{version: 1, name: "initial_archive_schema", apply: statementsStep(initialMigrationStatements)},
39: 		{version: 2, name: "add_google_identity_json", apply: statementsStep(googleIdentityJSONMigrationStatements)},
40: 		{version: 3, name: "add_source_family_filter", apply: statementsStep(sourceFamilyFilterMigrationStatements)},

44: 		{version: 7, name: "rename_profile_snapshots_to_identity_snapshots", apply: statementsStep(identitySnapshotsMigrationStatements)},
45: 		{version: 8, name: "add_current_settings_view", apply: registryViewsStep(8)},
46: 		{version: 9, name: "add_paired_devices_view", apply: registryViewsStep(9)},
47: 		{version: 10, name: "add_current_irn_profile_view", apply: registryViewsStep(10)},
48: 		{version: 11, name: "add_sleep_stages_and_exercise_splits_views", apply: registryViewsStep(11)},
49: 		// Version 12 drops the migration-11 exercise_splits view that
50: 		// extracted distance from $.distanceMeters (a path Google Health
51: 		// API does not emit) and recreates it against the real shape:
52: 		// $.metricsSummary.distanceMillimeters in millimeters. Live
53: 		// testing in the original #105 PR returned all-NULL distances;
54: 		// this is the follow-up that pins the view to what the upstream
55: 		// actually returns.
56: 		{version: 12, name: "fix_exercise_splits_real_shape", apply: recreateRegistryViewStep("exercise-splits", "exercise_splits")},
57: 		{version: 13, name: "add_searchable_text_view", apply: registryViewsStep(13)},

59: 		// recreates it from the Registry. The new definition restricts
60: 		// the profile kind to the latest snapshot per Connection and
61: 		// filters empty-string values from data_source and exercise_type
62: 		// rows (Copilot findings on PR #121).
63: 		{version: 14, name: "fix_searchable_text_latest_profile_and_empty_filter", apply: recreateRegistryViewStep("searchable-text", "searchable_text")},

70: 		// daily_sleep_temperature_derivations,

72: 		// hydration_log_sessions view ships separately at schema version
73: 		// 21 so the migration row history records the two payload shapes

81: 		{version: 20, name: "add_tier2_ecg_irn_views", apply: registryViewsStep(20)},

85: 		// standard session timing columns. The daily/sample Tier 1

87: 		{version: 21, name: "add_hydration_log_sessions_view", apply: registryViewsStep(21)},

91: 		// `sync --status` reader can tell an alive long run from an
92: 		// abandoned one. NULL on historical rows: those predate

111: 		}},

115: // applyMigrations creates the full current schema on a fresh, empty
116: // Health Archive by applying every table row from version 1. The
117: // caller's clock stamps schema_migrations.applied_at.
118: func applyMigrations(ctx context.Context, db *sql.DB, now func() time.Time) error {
119: 	tx, err := db.BeginTx(ctx, nil)
120: 	if err != nil {
121: 		return err
122: 	}
123: 	// Rollback after a successful Commit returns sql.ErrTxDone; the error is
124: 	// deliberately ignored because this defer is only the abort path.
125: 	defer func() { _ = tx.Rollback() }()
126: 	if err := applySchemaMigrationSteps(ctx, tx, 0, currentSchemaVersion, now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339)); err != nil {
127: 		return err
128: 	}
129: 	if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, fmt.Sprintf(`PRAGMA user_version = %d`, currentSchemaVersion)); err != nil {
130: 		return err
131: 	}
132: 	return tx.Commit()
133: }

135: // applyPendingMigrations upgrades an existing Health Archive from its
136: // recorded schema version to the current one, applying only the table
137: // rows the archive has not reached yet.
138: func applyPendingMigrations(ctx context.Context, db *sql.DB, now func() time.Time) error {
139: 	var userVersion int
140: 	if err := db.QueryRowContext(ctx, `PRAGMA user_version`).Scan(&userVersion); err != nil {
141: 		return err
142: 	}
143: 	switch {
144: 	case userVersion == currentSchemaVersion:
145: 		return nil
146: 	case userVersion >= 1 && userVersion < currentSchemaVersion:
147: 		tx, err := db.BeginTx(ctx, nil)
148: 		if err != nil {
149: 			return err
150: 		}
151: 		// Rollback after a successful Commit returns sql.ErrTxDone; the error is
152: 		// deliberately ignored because this defer is only the abort path.
153: 		defer func() { _ = tx.Rollback() }()
154: 		if err := applySchemaMigrationSteps(ctx, tx, userVersion, currentSchemaVersion, now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339)); err != nil {
155: 			return err
156: 		}
157: 		if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, fmt.Sprintf(`PRAGMA user_version = %d`, currentSchemaVersion)); err != nil {
158: 			return err
159: 		}
160: 		return tx.Commit()
161: 	default:
162: 		return fmt.Errorf("schema version %d, want %d", userVersion, currentSchemaVersion)
163: 	}

166: // applySchemaMigrationSteps runs every schema migration step with
167: // fromVersion < version <= toVersion, in table order, recording one
168: // schema_migrations history row per applied step. The caller owns the
169: // transaction and the closing PRAGMA user_version write.
170: func applySchemaMigrationSteps(ctx context.Context, tx *sql.Tx, fromVersion, toVersion int, appliedAt string) error {
171: 	for _, migration := range schemaMigrationTable() {
172: 		if migration.version <= fromVersion || migration.version > toVersion {
173: 			continue
174: 		}
175: 		if err := migration.apply(ctx, tx); err != nil {
176: 			return err
177: 		}
178: 		if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, `INSERT INTO schema_migrations (version, name, applied_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?)`, migration.version, migration.name, appliedAt); err != nil {
179: 			return err
180: 		}
181: 	}
182: 	return nil
183: }
